findings.summary: File entries omit required ownership, digest, portability, preservation, timing, and supersession fields.
Managed-section records omit marker, section-content, preimage, update, and surrounding-content preservation fields and lack marker conflict fixtures.
Q43 ownership migration is not implemented or exposed by the CLI.
Duplicate target paths and case-fold path collisions validate with no refusal, and the broader conflict model is absent.
The fixture corpus lacks required direct cases for managed-section conflicts, path collisions, Q43 migration, and several ownership classes.
